name: mailchimp-transactional
description: Send and diagnose transactional emails via Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill). Check account status, build templates, call any Transactional API endpoint, and diagnose failed sends — all through Mailchimp's official hosted MCP server.

connection.instructions: Log in to Mailchimp, then go to Transactional (Mandrill) → Settings → SMTP & API Info → Add API Key. Copy the generated key and paste it below.

fields.name: MANDRILL_API_KEY
fields.label: Mandrill API Key
fields.helpText: Found under Mailchimp Transactional → Settings → SMTP & API Info. If using a restricted key, enable the 'AI Agents' permission group. Stored encrypted in your personal credentials vault.
